procedure PotteryOpenStudioEmails {
  about "Send open studio emails to active members"
  policy PotteryPolicy
  sheet Members "Members" { member: Text, email: Email, kiln_slots: Number, renews: Date, status: Text, payment_notes: Text private }
  trigger every friday at 12:00

  let active = filter all where status == "active"
  let n = summarize count of active

  let msgs = draft each r in active up to 60 sms to r.email: "Hi {r.member default 'there'}, this is an open studio night at our pottery studio. Please join us!"
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 1 hour else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

  send ok
}
